source_en: New crack, left panel. Gvantsa Edisherashvili, political science student.
Four people every six minutes. I've counted since the barriers went up.
Because nobody else is. If I stop recording, the data disappears.
It keeps me from thinking about everything else. That's the point.
Everyone here looks at papers now, not faces. They've stopped trusting faces.
Faces are no longer reliable data. Two notebooks of proof so far.
Mother and sister. My sister wanted out. I stayed to count.
Check my stamp. Everyone forgets the stamp.
